title: WARP: A Word-Level Backdoor Attack Targeting RAG Systems via Retrieval Corpus Poisoning

problem.claim: RAG systems rely on corpus retrieval to address hallucination, outdated knowledge, and limited domain coverage, but corpus access creates a security vulnerability.

gap.claim: The abstract identifies a previously unaddressed or newly exposed attack surface in which adversaries inject trigger-embedded malicious documents into the retrieval corpus.

narrative_sequence.summary: RAG systems retrieve relevant documents from a corpus database to mitigate hallucination, outdated knowledge, and limited domain coverage.
Corpus poisoning with trigger-embedded malicious documents may cause an LLM to produce attacker-controlled outputs.

unknowns: The abstract units do not describe the WARP method or its word-level attack mechanism.
The abstract units provide no experimental setup, datasets, metrics, results, or limitations.
